title: Ultraplan Research Preview and Plan Mode Enhancements
description: Anthropic launched Ultraplan, a cloud-based planning feature accessible from CLI that allows users to draft plans and review them in a web editor before remote execution. Ultraplan finishes in minutes versus 30-45 minutes for local plan mode. Additionally, new CLI capabilities allow Claude to open native applications, click through UI elements, test its own changes, and fix issues directly from the terminal.

title: Adaptive Model Router and Bug Fixes
description: Windsurf (Codeium) released version 1.9600.41 on April 7, 2026, fixing a bug with the adaptive model router that prevented switching models after the first request. The Adaptive model intelligently selects the best model for each task to help users make quota last longer. All affected users had quota reset and overage restored. Version 1.9600.40 also improved visibility of the adaptive model in the model picker.

title: Background Agents in Slack Integration
description: Cursor now supports launching Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read the thread context, understand ongoing discussions, investigate issues, and create PRs in GitHub without leaving the conversation. The feature requires admin setup via Dashboard → Integrations page.
